assessment: Week 16 Performance Reliability and Deployment Evaluation
notes: Preissued fictional tokens; login/password hashing is outside the load measurement. Closed-loop workers wait for responses; offered traffic is not an open arrival-rate model. The submit/return operation makes two HTTP requests and is not an approval of a real student. Both environments share one host and use a single PHP built-in server worker. Targets are fixed before measurement and are prototype acceptance goals, not institution-supplied SLAs.
